### SubagentSource

```ts
type SubagentSource = Readonly<{
  hasLiveChildCommand: (sessionId) => boolean;
  read: (
    sessionId,
    limit,
  ) => Promise<
    Readonly<{
      agents: readonly SubagentRecord[];
      more: number;
    }>
  >;
  open: (
    agentId,
    signal,
  ) => Promise<
    Readonly<{
      agent: SubagentAgent;
      release: () => Promise<void>;
    }>
  >;
}>;
```

The host's read-only facts. `read` returns ordinary created Agents, at most
`limit`, with a count of the rest; `open` is the host's existing per-operation
Agent access (an `AgentControlDirectory`'s `open` fits), and releasing it never
stops the Agent's work.

## Functions

### subagentsExtension()

```ts
function subagentsExtension(options): RosteredExtensionV0;
```

The read-only footer: ordinary Agents created by this Agent, one row each, with
their live status. It owns neither relationships nor durable state; the Agent
directory owns immutable creation attribution. Its one command, `/agents`, only
expands or collapses the footer rows.
